## Scope conclusion

This candidate proves only the bounded selected `linux/amd64` guest-substrate recheck qualification authorized by Issue #7. It does not grant or consume dependency materialization, resolver/package-manager execution, project runtime, source import, PDF provider/runtime execution, distribution, `004C2`, `004D`, Specification 005, release, deployment, or project-completion authority. Merge qualification requires a fresh independent substantive review bound to the exact candidate head/tree, zero unresolved material findings, immediate premerge race proof, guarded normal merge with `expected_head_sha`, mechanical post-merge verification, and fresh Issue #7 successor reconciliation.
